related_questions.question: What happened to Forethought Life Insurance Company?

text_blocks.snippet: Forethought Life Insurance Company was acquired by Global Atlantic Financial Group in 2014. Global Atlantic, a multi-line insurance and reinsurance company, acquired Forethought, which included its life insurance and annuity operations. Forethought continues to operate under the Global Atlantic umbrella, with clients experiencing a seamless transition and continuity of service, according to Global Atlantic.

list.title: September 2013:
list.snippet: Global Atlantic announced its agreement to acquire Forethought Financial Group.

list.title: Early 2014:
list.snippet: The acquisition was completed, with Forethought becoming part of Global Atlantic.

list.title: Ongoing:
list.snippet: Forethought continues to operate, offering life insurance and annuity products, but as a subsidiary of Global Atlantic.
Global Atlantic itself became a majority-owned subsidiary of the public company KKR.
KKR increased its ownership stake to 100%, making Global Atlantic a wholly-owned subsidiary, according to Global Atlantic.
